title: How to Create a Custom 404 Page in WordPress with Visual Composer

facts.fact: Visual Composer's own claim is that its Hub offers over 300 predefined template solutions for building a 404 page, customizable to fit a brand.
facts.quote: Visual Composer offers over 300 predefined template solutions that are customizable to fit your brand.

facts.fact: The article was posted on July 29, 2021 and later updated on October 4, 2021.
The page defines a 404 error as an error that occurs when a user is trying to reach a non-existent page.
facts.quote: A 404 Page - also know as HTTP 404, 404 Not Found, 404, 404 Error, Page Not Found - is an error that occurs when a user is trying to reach a non-existent page.

facts.fact: The page lists three situations that produce a 404 error: a user mistyping a URL, a page that was deleted, moved, or renamed without a redirect while old backlinks persist, and a website that is down due to overcapacity, maintenance, or a crash.
facts.quote: A 404 Error happens when: 1. A user is typing a domain URL by hand and misspells.

facts.fact: The page states that all listed 404 page best-practice elements are optional, and the site owner decides how simple or extensive the page is.
facts.quote: Remember that all of the elements mentioned above are optional - it is up to you how simple or extensive you make it.
